Chapter 297: Chapter 6 Lucky Break (Please Subscribe)_2

Chapter 297: Chapter 6 Lucky Break (Please Subscribe)_2

Billions of civilization currency wasn’t a small amount, even for Fifth Rank or Sixth Rank Evolvers.

“Was it a reward?”

Lin Yuan checked the source of the civilization currency and found it originated from “rewards”.

The dozen or so videos I uploaded?

It was then that Lin Yuan remembered that a few days ago, to make training easier for Martial Arts Evolutionaries and to spread the Martial Path Evolutionary Path more quickly and widely, he had specifically recorded some training guidance videos.

With that thought, Lin Yuan immediately opened the ‘Yuan’ account and checked the comments under the videos.

...

“Hm?”

Lin Yuan raised an eyebrow.

There were over ten billion comments under each video, the majority of which were not from Martial Path Evolutionaries.

“They’re all urging me to update the videos with guidance on the second half of the Third Rank Chapter, the Fourth Rank Chapter, and the Fifth Rank Chapter?”

Lin Yuan glanced at them and slightly shook his head.

Such training guidance videos couldn’t be produced whenever one wished.

This had nothing to do with Lin Yuan’s understanding of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

Even if Lin Yuan understood it deeply, what use would it be if others couldn’t understand what he explained?

Therefore, the recording and production of such videos must use simple language that ordinary Evolutionaries could understand.

“Has the number of First Rank Martial Arts Evolutionaries increased substantially?”

Lin Yuan glanced at the real-time curve of the number of Evolutionaries at each stage of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

He found that since the day he posted the videos, the number of First Rank Martial Arts Evolutionaries had skyrocketed.

Moreover, the numbers of Second Rank and Third Rank Martial Arts Evolutionaries had also experienced a significant increase.

“Not bad, not bad.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

The surge in the number of Martial Arts Evolutionaries not only meant that Lin Yuan’s income would skyrocket.

It also increased a certain ‘foundation’ of Lin Yuan.

The latter was even more crucial.

…

At the border of the Human Civilization Territory in the cosmos.

The void slightly distorted.

A black spaceship appeared.

“The 862nd wormhole shuttle is complete, soon arriving at C24763 Alien Battlefield…”

The voice of the spaceship’s AI assistant resounded in Lin Yuan’s ears.

“Are we at the battlefield?”

Lin Yuanyang opened his eyes and looked ahead.

It had taken eighteen days to reach the C24763 Alien Battlefield since departing from Chikun Main Star.

“Is that the Alien Battlefield?”

Lin Yuan looked somewhat shocked.

He saw a continent floating in the cosmic starry sky in the extreme distance.

“C24763 Alien Battlefield, primarily a continent in shape, diameter of 0.2 light-years, that is, two trillion kilometers…”

Lin Yuan’s mind flashed with specific information about C24763 Alien Battlefield.

The cosmos is vast, planets are just the most common celestial bodies, but beyond planets, the depths of the universe contain many incredible celestial bodies.

A continent-shaped celestial body is not uncommon, many battlefields of different races are located on such massive objects measured in light-years.

“Where do we enter from?”

Lin Yuan began to determine the direction.

C24763 Alien Battlefield was immensely vast, and its surface was engulfed in a kind of cosmic energy forming a mist.

Usually, evolutionaries entering such a battlefield would randomly pick a direction to go in, and only once inside could they roughly determine their bearings.

“Let’s go.”

Lin Yuan controlled the spaceship, flying in one direction.

…

On the outskirts of C24763 Alien Battlefield.

Several figures stood in a mountain valley.

These figures exuded a strange and dark aura, belonging to the Heiyuan Clan from the cosmos.

The Heiyuan Clan, born from the Heiyuan Secret Realm, cultivated by absorbing the power of the Black Abyss.

Compared to regular cosmic energy, the power of the Black Abyss was sinister and peculiar, so when the Heiyuan Clan encountered the outside universe, they quickly secured their status.

They weren’t like other cosmic secret realms discovered, where the clans inside would be captured and relegated to being gardens for the Peak Clans, a much more miserable fate.

Of course.

The Heiyuan Clan’s ability to do so, and their timely affiliation with the Insect Race, offering the clan’s most precious Treasure — the Heart of the Black Abyss, also played a part.

With the protection of the Insect Race, most clans wouldn’t dare think about touching the Heiyuan Secret Realm.

“This spatial entrance likely comes from the efforts of an Eighth Layer strong being, or at least a Seventh Rank Monarch proficient in the Dao of Space.”

Several figures from the Heiyuan Clan, with the foremost figure staring at the slightly distorted spatial barrier in the corner of the valley.

The other Heiyuan Clan members were also excited.

On the Alien Battlefield, countless strong beings clashed, and occasionally, two strong beings would injure each other so badly neither could retreat to their own camps in time, forcing them to hurriedly hide in some secretive spot to recuperate.

But often, they wouldn’t recover from their injuries and would instead die from backlash.

Of course, before their deaths, these strong beings would have prepared themselves.

It wouldn’t be easy for outsiders to acquire the treasures they left behind.

Just like the current spatial entrance, being able to create a stable space definitely indicated a deep Understanding of Space Rules, and given its longevity without collapsing, at least nine hundred sixty-five basic spatial models had been thoroughly understood.

This meant the strong being was at least a Seventh Rank Monarch proficient in the Dao of Space, and more likely an Eighth Layer strong being.

The legacy possibly left by an Eighth Layer strong being… Thinking about this, the Heiyuan Clan members immediately became excited.

They were all Sixth Rank strong beings, facing what could be the legacy of an Eighth Layer strong being, maintaining their sanity was already quite restrained.

“It must have been left by some Human Race Evolver…”

The leading figure of the Heiyuan Clan carefully observed for a while, furrowing his brow slightly.

If this spatial entrance had been left by an Eighth Layer strong being from the Heiyuan Clan, they would dare to enter right away.
